subject: Status: repro validated post-VGG-fix, on-device gap
body:
Status.

Repro: good news — with the VGG-loss fix in place, training converges to quality consistent with the published results; our retrained checkpoint matches the released one within 0.4dB PSNR on the flare test images, so the historical training-code issue is behind us. The testing path (remove_flare.py) was never affected and we use it as the reference implementation for evals.

Own-data retraining: the semi-synthetic compositing recipe transfers, but our production lenses produce flare geometries — long radial streaks — underrepresented in the released flare library, so Rafael is capturing an extension set in the optics lab, about 600 additional flare images.

Risk: model size. Yusuf's first look suggests the full network misses the on-device latency budget by ~3x, so June feasibility likely lands on a distilled or tiled variant. Flagging so the pre-read doesn't promise on-device this year.

Tereza
